select bc.course_name, if(bctu.type = 1, if (bctu.change_type = 0, concat("新增", bctu.num, "课次"), concat("减少", bctu.num, "课次")), concat("手动修改总课次为", bctu.num)) operation , bctu.reason , su.nick_name operation_name from bd_course_time_update bctu left join bd_course bc on bc.id = bctu.course_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = bctu.create_by where bctu.student_id = #{studentId} and bctu.type in (1 , 5) order by bctu.create_time desc
, bctu.id desc
